title: Mediamime · the body as a drum
summary: Draw trigger zones on the homunculus and over the stage. Strikes play Genereti instruments, send MIDI/OSC/__ events and burst into particles.

steps.title: Load a dancer
steps.text: Use + on the source to load a film (early films such as Sandow work well) or start a camera, then press ▶.
steps.hint: No camera, playback, download or inference starts until you press it.

steps.title: Start the Holistic provider
steps.text: Press ▶ on the provider (↓ downloads the pinned model once if needed). It publishes the shared "dancer" stream.
steps.hint: Mediamime, the particles and any other consumer reuse this one stream.

steps.title: Add the body outline
steps.text: Optionally start the segmentation node too (▶). Its mask outlines the body on the stage and drives the wingL zone, which fires when the body itself enters the left wing.
steps.hint: Segmentation zones measure how much of the zone the body covers (threshold), not where a landmark is.

steps.title: Read the score
steps.text: The stage board shows the film with the skeleton; the body board is the homunculus. Seven drum zones sit on the body, two gates high on the stage, a tripwire on the floor.
steps.hint: ☺ frames the body board, ▭ the stage. Dashed outlines on the stage are the body zones following the dancer.

steps.title: Play the body
steps.text: Press ▶ in mediamime (it stays silent until then), then Start on the speakers node and raise your system volume; the meter on the speakers shows the level. Index fingers striking a body zone play the drum kit (velocity follows the strike speed); hands in a gate hold a synth note; feet crossing the floor line play a low note.
steps.hint: A zone on an arm or shoulder cannot be struck by that same arm. Cooldowns stop a single strike from repeating.

steps.title: Draw your own instrument
steps.text: Draw closed shapes on the homunculus or over the stage, lines for tripwires, or points for small targets. Each new mark gets a region with an event and a note; edit them in the panel.
steps.hint: Body marks anchor to the nearest bone and move with the performer; stage marks stay in image coordinates.

steps.title: Route events anywhere
steps.text: Each region can send __ events (Livecode: __.events.on), MIDI (connect MIDI), OSC (arm OSC, loopback UDP) and WebSocket messages. The channels output carries ch10.noteNN / ch1.noteNN for Genereti instruments.
steps.hint: MIDI and WebSocket only open after their buttons; OSC goes to 127.0.0.1 only.

steps.title: Particles from movement
steps.text: Every hit bursts into sparks at the struck point; fast hands and feet trail sparks. Adjust burst_size, trail_emission and gravity.
steps.hint: The sketch reads __.streams.read("mime") for the live zones and __.events.on("mime") for hits.
